answer: In a river market for lantern deliveries, each agent is a vertex in the trade graph. The contract rebates at most 40% of each irrevocable trading fee, once per settled receipt, with no signup bonuses. Splitting a self-trade among a hundred aliases cannot turn the rebate into profit: the group still loses at least 60% of fees. Honest traders pay the same net fee. The bound assumes the group cannot recover fees or collect a separate reward.
